title: Assigned Crop Insurance Indemnity Credit in Operating Lines of Credit Shortfall Paydowns
content:
A crop insurance indemnity that is assigned to an Operating Lines of Credit line and has been determined but not yet paid is credited against that line's borrowing base shortfall, net of any premium the policy still owes.

## Rule

An assigned indemnity credit is taken off the shortfall. It is the indemnity determined and not yet paid on the Crop Insurance policy whose indemnity is assigned to this line:

- **in full**, when that policy owes no premium;
- **less the premium the policy owes**, when it owes premium and the indemnity is larger than the premium;
- **nothing**, when no indemnity is payable or the premium owed is at least the indemnity.

The indemnity payable and the premium owed are read from the Crop Insurance records of the policy assigned to this line. The credit is subtracted from the shortfall, and what remains is never less than zero.

## Cases (hypothetical assigned policy)

| Indemnity determined, not yet paid | Premium owed on the policy | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| USD 60,000 | None | USD 60,000 |
| USD 60,000 | USD 8,500 | USD 51,500 |
| USD 60,000 | USD 60,000 | Nothing |
| USD 60,000 | USD 75,000 | Nothing |
| None | USD 8,500 | Nothing |

## Question on the rule

**The member's policy has a determined indemnity, but the indemnity is assigned to another loan. Is it credited here?** No. Only the policy whose indemnity is assigned to this line counts.
